criteria_verification.evidence: Added `nats_test_server`, `nats_server_binary`, and `_free_tcp_port` fixtures to tests/conftest.py. criteria_verification.evidence: All NATS I/O routes through the in-process subprocess broker bound to a tmp_path JetStream store directory. criteria_verification.evidence: Each test gets a fresh subprocess broker (function-scoped fixture) and a fresh JetStream store dir under tmp_path — no fixture state outlives a single test. The capabilities tests rebind the module-level `_capability_registry` and use a `restore_capability_registry` snapshot/restore fixture so the binding is restored on teardown. Verified ordering-invariance by running the suite in both forward and reverse module order — both passed (8/8 each). pytest-randomly is not installed in the environment but the isolation contract is independently satisfied by per-test fixture scoping.
